thread:
marin: Quick heads-up from a new hire: samplekit onboarding notebook throws when following the function-calling example with json_mode and our org's auth middleware.

zeke: Error details?

marin: They pasted a snippet in the notebook that calls `create_profile` with function_call and json_mode=True. It fails when the auth-retry path kicks in. The tool input is a quoted JSON string instead of a dict and their handler does `payload['name']` which blows up.

sam: That matches a parity bug we saw before between TS / py SDKs. Which py SDK version?

marin: py 0.9.8 used in the binder image. The crash stack in student logs shows TypeError: string indices must be integers.

lia: Could the auth middleware be wrangling the body bytes and triggering an extra encode on retry? We wrap requests to refresh tokens in a retry decorator.

zeke: Possibly. We had one repro where a partial streaming error caused the reassembler to treat the final arguments as text and then the retry wrapper re-encoded it. On TS side we attempt json.loads on final strings; Python did not.

marin: I tried a local minimal script (no custom middleware) and couldn't repro, so suspect middleware interplay. But students hit it consistently in the binder image which has our token-refresh hook.

sam: Minimal mitigation for docs: show a defensive pattern in samplekit handlers: `args = message['function_call']['arguments']
if isinstance(args, str):
    try:
        args = json.loads(args)
    except Exception:
        pass`
And call out that some auth/retry combos can cause quoted JSON.

lia: For a proper fix I can add an integration test that layers our auth retry decorator in front of the SDK and runs function_call + json_mode with induced partial stream error. That should reproduce the middleware angle.

zeke: Good plan. Mohit's earlier patch to the stream coalescer (try one json.loads on final string) helped most cases; combining that with avoiding json.dumps on str inputs should make this robust. Also add a changelog entry so onboarding instructors know to update binder images.

ops-bot: Created issue #4472: "py-sdk: function_call.arguments can be quoted JSON when auth retry wraps streaming reassembly". Linked PR branch fix/auth-retry-coalesce. CI queued.

marin: I'll update the binder quickstart to include the defensive snippet and a note about the temporary workaround. Thanks! :thumbsup:
